challenges.says: The criterion "added to the policies already loaded and the structures are built" uses builder wording a product owner cannot follow, and it overlaps the single ADMX file criterion without saying how a template file differs from an ADMX file.
The resize criterion cites only layer-web and a scope decision, not a rule, so it states fit-to-pane behaviour (no horizontal scroll bar, labels fitting) that no cited sentence carries.

The value-writing criterion drops parts of the cited rule: text lists have items double-quoted with quotes doubled, tables have double-quoted name: value lines, and text is single-quoted with no escaping, which is why quotes or line breaks cannot be read back.
